title: On normality and $\varphi$-normality of holomorphic functions in several complex variables
summary: In this paper, we investigate $\varphi$-normal functions and normal families of holomorphic functions concerning total derivatives in $\mathbb{C}^{n}.$ More precisely, we prove a sufficient condition for a holomorphic function defined on an open unit ball in $\mathbb{C}^{n}$ satisfying certain conditions involving higher order partial derivatives to be $\varphi$-normal.
